# [STORY] As a User, I want on-demand backend deployment and 1-hour inactivity auto-stop

## User Story
**As a** visitor or developer
**I want** the cloud backend to start automatically on-demand and auto-stop after 1 hour of inactivity
**So that** visitors experience seamless live streaming while cloud compute costs remain at $0 when idle.

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given a stopped or idle cloud backend, when a visitor opens the frontend, then a wake-up signal is triggered and a countdown standby modal is displayed.
- [x] Given the backend is booting, when health checks poll `/actuator/health`, then the modal tracks progress and auto-dismisses upon HTTP 200 OK.
- [x] Given 1 hour of inactivity with no user requests, when the watchdog runs, then the cloud compute nodes (Azure AKS or AWS EC2) are stopped.
- [x] Given an operator running `./gradlew startAzure`/`stopAzure` or `startAws`/`stopAws`, then the respective compute nodes start or stop on demand.

## Definition of Ready

Supported across both Azure AKS and AWS EC2 (k3s) with automatic health-checking and RTK Query state invalidation.
